words.gloss_range: definite relative pronoun continuing the prior divine referent and opening an attributive proof clause
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلَّذِى}} ({{tr:alladhī}}) keeps the subject from 36:79 active instead of starting a new scene. Its relative form turns the whole making clause into another divine attribute: the same one who knows every creation is now described by the concrete act of making fire available from the green tree.

topics.headline: continued divine relative subject
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that 36:80 continues the identified divine subject from 36:79 rather than introducing an unnamed new actor.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence identify the word as a masculine singular relative pronoun whose antecedent lies outside this ayah, with the following verb's subject recovered through that relative head.

topics.headline: relative clause as proof attribute
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the fire-from-tree scene functions as a descriptive credential of the divine agent, not as a detached observation.
topics.reason: The relative pronoun opens a ṣila clause, and the clause evidence treats the making clause as a relative description leading into the result clause.

words.gloss_range: made, rendered, established, or brought about; here a completed divine making that transforms source material into usable fire for the addressees
words.root_gloss_range: broad making and rendering field, with other branches such as naming, auxiliary beginning, reward, and unrelated nominal branches not locally selected

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: beneficiary phrase for the addressees under the making verb

accusative fire product of the making act

words.prose: {{ar:جَعَلَ}} ({{tr:jaʿala}}) is active and perfect, so the fire-source capacity is presented as an already established divine act, not an anonymous process still becoming. Its argument frame gathers the beneficiary {{ar:لَكُم}} ({{tr:lakum}}), the source {{ar:مِّنَ ٱلشَّجَرِ}} ({{tr:mina l-shajari}}), and the product {{ar:نَارًۭا}} ({{tr:nāran}}), making one compact transformation: provision is made from an unlikely source and handed into human use. The same making verb also joins the surah's sign vocabulary, while 28:38 supplies a contrastive field where a human ruler commands ignition rather than receiving fire as provision.

topics.headline: active completed divine making
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the source-capacity is already established by the same divine subject, not left as an impersonal natural fact.
topics.reason: QAC marks a perfect active Form I verb with 3ms agreement, and attachment evidence recovers the subject through the relative head.

topics.headline: beneficiary, source, and product under one verb
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees benefit, source, and product as distinct roles organized by one making act.
topics.reason: The verb instance has an explicit object and two prepositional complements, with {{ar:لَكُم}} ({{tr:lakum}}) as beneficiary, {{ar:مِن}} ({{tr:min}}) source, and {{ar:نَارًۭا}} ({{tr:nāran}}) as explicit object.

topics.headline: making range narrowed to transformative provision
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the verb as more than generic making: it renders green tree material into a usable fire-provision, while unrelated root branches stay outside the local sense.
topics.reason: V4 supports making and rendering branches for {{ar:ج ع ل}} ({{tr:j-ʿ-l}}), but the local Form I verb plus source and product frame selects transformation and establishment, not naming, reward, or unrelated nominal branches.

topics.headline: making field in sign and agency contrasts
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can track {{ar:جَعَلَ}} ({{tr:jaʿala}}) as part of the surah's sign-making vocabulary and as an agency contrast with the command-and-kindling scene in 28:38.
topics.reason: The recurrence claims are usable as distributional and inter-ayah pressure, but they do not override the local parse of a completed divine making act.

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: independent second-person pronoun that later foregrounds the addressees
final second-person kindling verb in the result clause

words.prose: {{ar:لَكُم}} ({{tr:lakum}}) puts the addressees into the making event before the source and product are named. The fire is not merely observed as a fact in nature; it is framed as made for you, and that early bound address prepares the later shift to {{ar:أَنتُم}} ({{tr:antum}}) and {{ar:تُوقِدُونَ}} ({{tr:tūqidūna}}), where the same audience becomes active.

topics.headline: benefactive address before source and product
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the transformation is addressed as usable provision before its unlikely source is revealed.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes {{ar:لَكُم}} ({{tr:lakum}}) the beneficiary complement of {{ar:جَعَلَ}} ({{tr:jaʿala}}), and its position precedes the source and product phrase.

topics.headline: second-person chain begins as benefit
topics.reader_payoff: The reader tracks the same audience moving from recipients of provision to visible agents of kindling.
topics.reason: The 2mp suffix is surface-form evidence for the direct addressees and begins the local chain that later appears as an independent pronoun and verb agreement.

words.prose: {{ar:مِّنَ}} ({{tr:mina}}) makes the green tree the source from which the fire is made, not merely the cause beside which fire appears. By placing the source phrase before {{ar:نَارًۭا}} ({{tr:nāran}}), the ayah makes the reader process the unlikely origin first; the later {{ar:مِّنْهُ}} ({{tr:minhu}}) then resumes the same source line after the pivot. The nasal onset of {{ar:مِّنَ}} ({{tr:mina}}) also leans into the following tree phrase, so the source marker is audibly joined to what it governs.

topics.headline: source relation narrowed from broader min range
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees fire as emerging from the tree-source, with partitive pressure serving extraction rather than replacing the source relation.
topics.reason: The preposition governs {{ar:ٱلشَّجَرِ}} ({{tr:al-shajari}}) as the source complement of {{ar:جَعَلَ}} ({{tr:jaʿala}}); causal or temporal alternatives are not selected locally.

topics.headline: full source naming before pronominal return
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the movement from full source naming to later compressed source recovery.
topics.reason: The first {{ar:مِن}} ({{tr:min}}) governs the explicit green-tree phrase, while the later {{ar:مِّنْهُ}} ({{tr:minhu}}) resumes the same source by pronoun.

topics.headline: nasal source onset
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the source marker lean into the following tree phrase rather than sitting as an isolated particle.
topics.reason: The row gives a local acoustic payoff tied to the visible source particle and its governed noun phrase.

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلشَّجَرِ}} ({{tr:al-shajari}}) is a definite collective source noun, so the argument rests on a familiar class of tree-growth rather than one named tree. Its genitive role under {{ar:مِّنَ}} ({{tr:mina}}) keeps tree as source and {{ar:نَارًۭا}} ({{tr:nāran}}) as product, while the root's branching and interlocking image makes the source feel like living structured material from which fire is surprisingly drawn. The phrase presses that living source directly against the burning product, and the doubled {{ar:ش}} ({{tr:sh}}) after the article gives the tree noun an audible density before the fire appears. The 24:35 echo remains a narrowed inter-ayah comparison: both places join tree with the light-fire field, but 36:80 makes the tree a usable fire-source.

topics.headline: definite collective source class
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the source as a recognizable class of tree-growth, not a one-off species name or isolated tree.
topics.reason: QAC marks a definite collective noun, and the variant evidence can be used only to show collective pressure without replacing the standard reading.

topics.headline: tree as governed source, not product
topics.reader_payoff: The reader keeps the tree as the grammatical origin and fire as the result, preserving the source-product contrast.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes {{ar:ٱلشَّجَرِ}} ({{tr:al-shajari}}) the genitive complement of {{ar:مِن}} ({{tr:min}}), while {{ar:نَارًۭا}} ({{tr:nāran}}) is the accusative object.

topics.headline: branching growth narrowed toward fire-source material
topics.reader_payoff: The reader imagines fire drawn from living, branching, interlocked growth, while the botanical source remains the selected local sense.
topics.reason: V4 supports woody plant and entangled/interlocked branches for {{ar:ش ج ر}} ({{tr:sh-j-r}}), but the local noun and source frame select tree material; dispute and other branches can only color the image if they do not replace it.

topics.headline: tree and light-fire echo with 24:35
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can compare 36:80 with 24:35 as two tree-and-light-fire scenes while keeping 36:80's local focus on extracted usable fire.
topics.reason: The cross-reference rows give concrete inter-ayah evidence, but it remains a contrastive echo rather than a controlling parse.

topics.headline: living source thickens the green-fire paradox
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the living tree-source pressed directly against the burning product in syntax, sound, and sense.
topics.reason: The phrase places the green tree before the fire product, and the sound row offers a local acoustic payoff tied to the doubled onset of the source noun.

words.gloss_range: green as an inherent adjective of the source tree, carrying freshness, moisture, and living vitality into direct contrast with fire
words.root_gloss_range: green color and fresh growth are active; prosperity and other idiomatic branches can color the vitality field only generally, while legal, wasted-blood, vessel, and proper-name branches are not local

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْأَخْضَرِ}} ({{tr:al-akhḍari}}) is grammatically locked to the tree, not to the fire: its genitive, definite, masculine adjectival form keeps greenness inside the source phrase. The color is not a flat label; it brings freshness, moisture, and living vitality to the threshold of {{ar:نَارًۭا}} ({{tr:nāran}}), so the proof turns on fire coming from what looks least fire-ready. This exact green-tree pairing is locally conspicuous, and the rougher articulation of {{ar:خ}} ({{tr:kh}}) and {{ar:ض}} ({{tr:ḍ}}) lets the color word stand firmly before the abrupt fire noun. The recurrence links to green grain in 12:43 and 12:46, and to water-growth scenes in 6:99 and 22:63, are useful as narrowed background because 36:80 redirects that greenness field into combustion.

topics.headline: greenness attached to the source tree
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the ayah says fire from a green tree, not green fire.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes {{ar:ٱلْأَخْضَرِ}} ({{tr:al-akhḍari}}) the adjective of {{ar:ٱلشَّجَرِ}} ({{tr:al-shajari}}), with agreement in definiteness and genitive case.

topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the source as fresh and moist, which sharpens the surprise of combustion rather than merely naming a color.
topics.reason: V4 supports green color and fresh green growth branches, while the local adjective and fire adjacency select vitality and moisture pressure rather than unrelated idioms.

topics.reader_payoff: The reader experiences the antithesis at the exact phrase edge: green immediately gives way to fire.
topics.reason: The adjective intervenes immediately before the accusative fire product, preserving the source-product reversal without adding a conjunction.

topics.reader_payoff: The reader can hear familiar Quranic greenness and water-growth imagery redirected into a fire-source scene.

topics.reason: The low occurrence profile and the row's specific pairing claim support salience, while the sound observation remains a local acoustic payoff.

words.prose: {{ar:نَارًۭا}} ({{tr:nāran}}) arrives as an indefinite accusative product: fire as a usable kind, not one named flame. Because it lands only after {{ar:مِنَ ٱلشَّجَرِ ٱلْأَخْضَرِ}} ({{tr:mina l-shajari l-akhḍari}}), the reader must hold the unlikely green source before receiving the product. It is the explicit object of {{ar:جَعَلَ}} ({{tr:jaʿala}}) and later the recoverable object of {{ar:تُوقِدُونَ}} ({{tr:tūqidūna}}), with nasal resonance helping tie the fire noun forward to the final action. The root field keeps illumination near the combustible sense, and the comparison with 24:35 is narrowed: 36:80 says fire from green tree, while 24:35 develops the tree-light lamp field.

topics.headline: indefinite fire as repeatable product kind
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees fire as a general usable category, matching repeated human kindling rather than a single named flame.
topics.reason: QAC marks the noun as indefinite accusative and a second object/product of {{ar:جَعَلَ}} ({{tr:jaʿala}}).

topics.headline: one fire links making and kindling

topics.headline: combustible fire with light pressure

topics.reason: V4 supports fire and light branches for {{ar:ن و ر}} ({{tr:n-w-r}}), but local syntax with the kindling verb selects combustible fire; illumination is a retained pressure, not a replacement gloss.

topics.headline: 24:35 tree-light-kindling echo
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can compare 36:80 and 24:35 as linked by tree, light-fire, and kindling while preserving their different local scenes.
topics.reason: The rows give a concrete 24:35 cross-reference, but the echo is contrastive and does not make {{ar:نَارًۭا}} ({{tr:nāran}}) mean abstract light in 36:80.

topics.reason: The fire noun follows the full source phrase, and the sound row ties the product to the later kindling verb through local cadence.

words.prose: {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) is the hinge from divine making to human kindling. Its scope covers the whole {{ar:أَنتُم مِّنْهُ تُوقِدُونَ}} ({{tr:antum minhu tūqidūna}}) result clause, so the second half is not a new independent scene; it is the immediate, explanatory consequence of the fire made from the green tree. Bound directly to {{ar:إِذَآ}} ({{tr:idhā}}), {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) makes consequence and surprise arrive together in the audible pivot {{ar:فَإِذَآ}} ({{tr:fa-idhā}}).

words.prose: {{ar:إِذَآ}} ({{tr:idhā}}) is surprise {{ar:إِذَآ}} ({{tr:idhā}}), not a conditional when. After {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}), it opens a sudden scene that begins with {{ar:أَنتُم}} ({{tr:antum}}): behold, the addressees themselves are kindling from the source. The hamza after {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) gives the pivot a small acoustic arrest, and the long final vowel holds the turn just before direct address. The pivot therefore changes a stated divine act into directly witnessed human practice.

topics.reason: The rows tie the construction to the ayah's division into two halves, with the glottal onset supplying a local acoustic payoff.

words.prose: {{ar:أَنتُم}} ({{tr:antum}}) makes the addressees visible before the verb that already marks them. The audience first appeared as beneficiaries in {{ar:لَكُم}} ({{tr:lakum}}); here they stand independently at the start of the result scene, and the final verb will carry them again. That bound-suffix, detached-pronoun, verb-ending reprise keeps the addressees audibly present, with the nasal frame of {{ar:أَنتُم}} ({{tr:antum}}), {{ar:مِّنْهُ}} ({{tr:minhu}}), and {{ar:تُوقِدُونَ}} ({{tr:tūqidūna}}) binding the result clause. The proof therefore lands not on people in general, but on you yourselves doing the kindling.

topics.reason: Attachment evidence identifies {{ar:أَنتُم}} ({{tr:antum}}) as the explicit pronominal subject emphasized before {{ar:تُوقِدُونَ}} ({{tr:tūqidūna}}).

words.prose: {{ar:مِّنْهُ}} ({{tr:minhu}}) compresses the earlier source phrase into a preposition plus pronoun. The masculine suffix points back to {{ar:ٱلشَّجَرِ}} ({{tr:al-shajari}}), not to the feminine {{ar:نَارًۭا}} ({{tr:nāran}}), so the ayah closes the circuit: fire is made from the green tree, and from it the addressees kindle. Its nasal sequence also leans into {{ar:تُوقِدُونَ}} ({{tr:tūqidūna}}), making the compressed source phrase audibly carry into the kindling verb.

words.prose: {{ar:تُوقِدُونَ}} ({{tr:tūqidūna}}) closes the ayah on the addressees' active, repeated kindling. Form IV makes them causers of burning, the imperfect makes the action habitual, and the second-person ending keeps the audience inside the final word. Yet the agency is carefully bounded: humans activate fire from a source already made by God, and the omitted object is recoverable from {{ar:نَارًۭا}} ({{tr:nāran}}), so the divine making and human kindling remain joined without being confused. The wider kindling field includes 13:17 and 24:35, but here the marked active Form IV imperfect specializes that field as ordinary source-activation from the green tree, ending with a long {{ar:ون}} ({{tr:ūn}}) close that lets the human action ring at the ayah's edge.

topics.reason: QAC and verb-instance evidence identify a Form IV active imperfect, and V4 supports the kindling/causing-fire branch for {{ar:و ق د}} ({{tr:w-q-d}}).

topics.headline: human activation, not origination

topics.reason: The ayah divides agency between completed divine making in the first clause and repeated human kindling from that source in the result clause.

topics.reason: Distributional and cross-reference evidence is meaningful, but the local Form IV imperfect with {{ar:مِّنْهُ}} ({{tr:minhu}}) selects source-based kindling rather than lamp, smelting, command, or nonliteral war imagery as the controlling sense.

topics.reason: The verb is the ayah's final word and completes the shift from theological claim into empirical practice.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The state-making verb, the two min-source relations, the green-tree phrase, the fire object, and the second-person ignition verb.
baseline_models.mechanism: A made material affordance joins divine production to human operation: a stalked green source is rendered as fire-bearing material, but the disclosed capacity becomes actual flame when the addressed humans ignite it.

activation_trace.role: State-transformation is the literal range and supplies the making-to-usable-condition step.
The stalked tree is the literal material carrier from which the affordance is obtained.
Tender green vegetation marks the source as actively vegetal rather than already ash or inert residue.
Kindled fire is the literal output and the usable energetic state made available.
Igniting and burning are literal here and assign the addressed humans the threshold action.

changed_reading.before: The ayah reports the curious fact that fire can come from a green tree.
changed_reading.after: The ayah stages a two-agent mechanism: the source is made capable and available for humans, then human ignition actualizes that latent capacity.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The direct source relation between green tree and fire, followed by immediate ignition from the same source.
baseline_models.mechanism: The construction places thriving vegetal material and burning in one carrier. Green and fire are not merely contrasted; the first state conceals or supports the second, with ignition functioning as the release boundary.

activation_trace.role: Thriving, ease, and freshness intensify the source state whose fiery capacity appears counterintuitive.
Interlocking load-bearing wood gives the literal carrier a structure able to hold and transmit another state.
Light and illumination are the perceptible release from the apparently contrary green source.
Fuel as ignition-material makes latent capacity, rather than an unrelated external fire, the mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Green life and hot fire are two opposed things juxtaposed for wonder.
changed_reading.after: The green carrier is read as holding a contrary-seeming energetic future, and kindling reveals continuity between the two states.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier community passes suddenly into khumud, a word whose inventory joins a stilled flame with stilled life or awareness; the focus later passes suddenly into active ignition. The inverse constructions turn flame-state into a compact model of animation being withdrawn and activated.

activation_trace.role: A flame becoming still while embers remain supplies the literal inverse of the focus ignition.
Life or awareness falling still extends that flame image to the destroyed human collective.
Actual fire supplies the state whose removal and return organize the inverse.
Active ignition supplies the positive pole opposite the earlier stilling.

structural_cues: 36:29 and 36:80 both use fa-idha plus a human pronoun, but end in extinguishing and kindling respectively.
The surah places the inverse clauses inside repeated sudden state transitions.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the matched sudden clauses and the flame/life branches of khumud; I infer that ignition and de-animation illuminate one another, while a live alternative is that the repetition marks suddenness without establishing a shared ontology.

changed_reading.before: The focus gives a self-contained firemaking example.
changed_reading.after: The focus reverses the surah's earlier human extinguishing: kindling becomes a small enacted model for the recoverability of animation from a latent state.

context_deltas.mechanism: Dead land is enlivened and yields concealed produce; decayed bone is set beside first origination and renewed creation. Green matter yielding flame becomes the accessible middle case in a chain where a material's present state does not exhaust the states that can be brought out of it.

activation_trace.role: Spiritless dead land supplies an apparently exhausted material state.
Land living through rain and growth supplies a witnessed reversal into productivity.
Bringing something out of concealment makes emergence, not replacement, the operative relation.
Decay and disintegration supply the apparently terminal state challenged by the sequence.
Bringing a thing into existence supplies the first-production side of the analogy.
Repeated creative origination expands the state-change mechanism beyond the local material example.
Making something assume a condition locates the focus inside the larger sequence of transformations.
Living green material supplies the nonterminal source state.
Observable ignition makes the larger claim testable at ordinary human scale.

structural_cues: 36:33 runs dead earth to revival to emergence from it to human use.
36:77-81 runs initial human material to dispute, decayed bones, first origination, green-to-fire, and renewed creation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies several state reversals and a contiguous creation argument; I infer that the focus is a middle-scale material demonstration of nonterminal states, while the live alternative is that it is only one analogy among several rather than a common mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Green-to-fire is an isolated marvel used beside a claim about renewed creation.
changed_reading.after: Green-to-fire is the manipulable middle link in a surah-wide process grammar: dead, living, decayed, green, and burning are transformable states rather than final identities.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated visible signs and repeated demands to see change the focus from reported evidence into a demonstration performed by the addressees. Light is the perceptible result, and the second-person ignition makes the witness participate in producing the evidence.

activation_trace.role: A manifest mark establishes the surah's category of evidence available to perception.
Seeing by eye and insight supplies the expected response to created affordances.
Visible illumination makes the focus phenomenon self-disclosing.
The audience's own ignition turns observation into a repeatable act.

structural_cues: 36:33, 36:37, and 36:41 open natural and material sequences as signs.
The focus combines 'for you' with 'you kindle', moving the addressee from spectator to operator.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies manifest-sign language, seeing prompts, visible light, and second-person action; I infer an enacted proof in which the witness operates the sign, while the alternative is that the second person marks ordinary utility without an evidentiary function.

changed_reading.before: The speaker cites an external natural sign for an audience to consider.
changed_reading.after: The audience is made the experimenter: by kindling the fire themselves, they generate the visible evidence that addresses their doubt.

context_deltas.mechanism: The created-for-them sequence moves through putting created things to work, making them tractable, receiving benefit, and being asked for gratitude. The focus continues that sequence with a material capacity made for humans and a skilled action they perform.

activation_trace.role: Putting a thing to use supplies the practical interface between created material and human benefit.
Facilitation after difficulty supplies the conversion of raw creation into an accessible affordance.
Concrete benefit names the human-facing output of the facilitation.
Recognition of benefit gives the use sequence an ethical response rather than treating technique as autonomous.
Rendering the material into a usable condition supplies the enabling side of the focus mechanism.
Human ignition supplies the learned operational side of the same mechanism.

structural_cues: 36:71-73 moves from creation to possession, riding, eating, benefits, drinking, and gratitude.
36:80 repeats the for-you orientation and ends with a second-person practical verb.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies facilitated materials, human use, benefit, gratitude, and focus ignition; I infer delegated technique as the connecting arrow, while the alternative is a simple inventory of favors with no claim about technological agency.

changed_reading.before: Fire from a tree is a divine product shown to humans.
changed_reading.after: Firemaking is delegated technique: created matter is made tractable, human skill releases its benefit, and that skill remains nested inside reception and gratitude.

context_deltas.mechanism: Daylight is stripped from a dark carrier and the humans suddenly stand in darkness; in the focus, firelight is brought from a green carrier and the humans suddenly stand kindling. The paired scenes make light and darkness removable or releasable layers rather than fixed properties of their carriers.

activation_trace.role: Peeling off a skin supplies the literal removal mechanism for a formerly covering layer.
Night's darkness is the carrier-state disclosed when daylight is removed.
Day opening through illumination supplies the light-layer that can be withdrawn.
The tender green carrier is the apparently nonfiery layer from which another state is released.
Illumination is the inverse perceptible layer disclosed through ignition.
Kindling supplies the release action opposed to the earlier stripping action.

structural_cues: 36:37 and 36:80 each use a from-it relation followed by fa-idha and a human pronoun.
The first transition discloses darkness by removing light; the second discloses light by activating fire.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the matched grammar, stripping, darkness, and ignition; I infer that the green source functions as a carrier concealing releasable light, while the alternative is a formal parallel without a shared layer model.

changed_reading.before: The green tree and fire are opposed substances.
changed_reading.after: Green and fire become carrier and disclosed layer, mirroring the surah's earlier removal of day from night in an inverse light-switch construction.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah pairs kinds, runs the sun on an ordered course, and lets the moon return to the image of an old dry palm stalk. Against that temporal field, green tree to flame can be carried as a delayed-return model: living growth receives a luminous regime, ages into fuel, and returns light as flame.

activation_trace.role: A counterpart joined to its counterpart supplies the paired-state frame for green material and flame.
The sun and its radiance supply the upstream luminous regime in the proposed material cycle.
Ordered determination supplies a regulated process rather than an accidental juxtaposition.
Return after departure supplies the temporal arrow by which an earlier condition reappears.
The old curved dry palm stalk supplies the aged vegetal phase between green growth and fuel.
Tender green growth supplies the receptive living phase of the proposed cycle.
Released illumination supplies the returning output.
Human kindling is the conversion event that makes delayed light perceptible again.

structural_cues: 36:36-40 moves from terrestrial pairs to measured light-bearing cycles and return to an old palm-stalk form.
36:80 reconnects vegetal material, firelight, and a human release action.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies paired kinds, solar radiance, ordered motion, return, an old dry stalk, green vegetation, and flame; I supply the arrow that growth stores light and combustion returns it, while the live alternative is the narrower fire-stick demonstration with no energy-cycle claim.

changed_reading.before: Green and fire form an instantaneous paradox.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the paradox unfolds in time: green growth is a phase in an ordered light cycle, and flame is delayed light returned through human kindling.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it moves from material combustion to reception of discourse. It remains anchored in the focus's green source, illumination, and second-person ignition and is activated by the adjacent sequence of recitation, warning, and the living hearer. Downstream prose should label it a cognitive metaphor and must not replace the physical or reanimation readings with it.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The living-green source, light-bearing fire, and addressed humans who perform the ignition.

activation_trace.role: Recitation supplies the communicative material offered for reception.
Warning that awakens caution supplies the activating effect of the discourse.
The living being supplies the receptive counterpart to the focus's green living material.
Tender green life supplies the focus anchor for receptive vitality.
Illumination supplies the cognitive result in the exploratory mapping.
The audience's ignition supplies active uptake rather than passive exposure.

changed_reading.before: Living vegetation is material from which people kindle literal fire.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, living receptivity is also kindling-material: recitation and warning become illumination only when a living addressee actively takes them up.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it maps literal human eating onto a fire's appetite. It remains valid as a material analogy because the packet's eating inventory explicitly contains feeding and igniting fire, the surah repeatedly routes created outputs into eating, and the focus names fuel and ignition. Downstream prose should call it a cross-domain provisioning model, not claim that the contextual eating verbs literally mean combustion.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The fire object, the from-it relation, and the fuel-and-ignition range of the final verb.

activation_trace.role: Feeding a fire and its burning supplies a branch-level bridge from produced food to combustible provision.
Repeated eating from a facilitated creature reinforces consumption as the output side of provision.
Actual fire supplies the second consumer in the cross-domain circuit.
Fuel material supplies what is fed into that second consumption process.

changed_reading.before: Earth and livestock feed humans, while the tree-to-fire scene is a separate benefit.
changed_reading.after: The focus completes a dual provisioning circuit: created matter feeds bodies as food and feeds flame as fuel, converting stored material into two forms of usable energy.

strongest_changes: The matched fa-idha clauses at 36:29 and 36:80 reverse human extinguishing into human ignition, making flame-state a model for withdrawn and restored animation.
Dead earth, decayed bone, first origination, and renewed creation turn green-to-fire into an ordinary-scale instance of nonterminal material states.
The 36:71-73 sequence makes second-person kindling delegated technique within facilitation, benefit, and gratitude.
Repeated sign and seeing language makes the audience an operator who produces the visible evidence rather than only hearing about it.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah context exposed two precise inverse constructions: daylight is stripped and humans suddenly darken, while firelight is released and humans suddenly kindle. It also opened a temporally extended reading in which green growth, an old dry stalk, celestial light, and flame participate in an ordered return rather than a one-moment paradox.
remaining_uncertainties: The delayed-return-of-light model depends on the reader-supplied storage arrow and should remain exploratory.
The layer model may reflect matched rhetoric rather than a shared material mechanism.
The living-reader and dual-feeding outliers are branch-licensed metaphors, not replacements for the physical and reanimation models.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Latent opposition is released from one material.** `ج ع ل` B002 turns into a state; `ش ج ر` B001 woody plant; `خ ض ر` B002 fresh green growth; `ن و ر` B002 burning fire; `و ق د` B001 kindling. Moist greenness yields fire when acted upon. I infer that observed material can contain a power opposite to its surface condition. The ayah reads as a direct analogue for life emerging from death.
2. **Human kindling participates in prior making.** The creator *made* fire available from the tree; humans then kindle *from it*. I infer a layered agency like handwork and fruit in 36:35: human activation is real but dependent on installed potential. The ayah reads as delegated transformation rather than independent production.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 36:81 made the green-tree reversal one step in a larger argument from cosmic creation; the material example is neither isolated marvel nor complete proof but a bridge of causal plausibility.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **One substrate carries apparently contrary states.** **ج ع ل B002** anchors turning something into a state; **ش ج ر B001** the woody plant; **خ ض ر B002** fresh moist growth; **ن و ر B002** burning fire; and **و ق د B001** ignition. The fixed **مِنَ / مِنْهُ** insists on material continuity from green tree to kindled fire; decayed bone and revival precede (36:78–79). The packet supplies the transformation; the inferred arrow is *if moist living matter can become its apparent opposite, altered bodily matter cannot by appearance alone delimit future state*. Fire from green wood is a local transformation model for resurrection.
2. **Human kindling reveals stored creative placement.** **و ق د B005** supplies readiness to ignite, while **ج ع ل B002** supplies prior state-making. The ayah distinguishes the one who placed fire-potential from the humans who actually kindle it. This role split is supplied; the abductive arrow is *human action releases a capacity it did not install*. The everyday act becomes participatory evidence for latent possibility.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: **Later surprise.** 36:81 generalizes the local tree transformation to heavens, earth, and human likeness; 36:82 identifies command as the enabling interface, and 36:83 encloses every transformed thing within dominion and return.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, bir kişiye yapacağı iş veya yerine getireceği görev karşılığında ayrılan ücret, ödeme ya da armağanı açıkça tanımlar. İnsanların bir sefer veya önemli iş için aralarında kararlaştırdıkları ortak ödemeler de aynı karşılık belirleme çekirdeğine bağlıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal iş veya görev karşılığında belirlenen ödemedir; genel armağanı, yapılan işi, durum değiştirmeyi ve tencere bezini kapsamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal yalın ad alanına dayanır; özel bir söz öbeğiyle sınırlı değildir.

concept_map.definition: Bir kişinin yapacağı iş veya görev karşılığında ona verilmek üzere belirlenen ücret, ödeme ya da armağandır. Bir topluluğun sefer veya önemli bir iş için aralarında kararlaştırdığı ödemeler de bu çekirdeğin özel bir gerçekleşmesidir.

facets.statement: Belirli bir iş veya görevin yapılması karşılığında bir kişiye ayrılan ücret, ödeme ya da armağandır.
Bir topluluğun sefer veya önemli bir iş sırasında kendi arasında kararlaştırdığı ortak ödemeleri de kapsar.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar iş karşılığında önceden ayrılan ücret veya armağanda birleşir; topluca kararlaştırılan ödemeler bu çekirdeğin özel biçimi olarak aktarılır.

concept_gloss.text: iş karşılığı belirlenen ücret veya ortaklaşa kararlaştırılan ödeme

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi tek bir nesne değil, bir araya getirilen ya da yerleştirilen ağaç parçalarının taşıma, dayama, asma ve engelleme görevleri üstlendiği bir nesne ailesi verir. Dal korunabilir, ancak tanım bu işlev çeşitlerini ortak bir ahşap düzenek çekirdeğine bağlamalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal canlı bitkiyi değil, taşıyan, dayayan, asan ya da engelleyen ahşap parçaları ve düzenekleri adlandırır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Adlar yalın biçimde ahşap nesne ve düzenekleri karşılar; başka dallardaki bitki ya da eylem kuruluşları buraya aktarılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir araya getirilmiş ya da belirli bir yere konmuş ağaç parçalarından oluşan taşıyıcı, dayanak, askı veya engeldir. Tahtırevan iskeleti, kuyu ve kapı ağaçları, giysi askısı ve yavrunun emmesini önleyen ağız çubuğu bu aileye girer.

facets.statement: Ağaç parçaları bir şeyi taşımak, dayamak, asmak ya da geçişi engellemek üzere yerleştirilir veya birleştirilir.
Birleşik ağaçlar tahtırevan ve benzeri insan taşıyan araçların iskeletini oluşturabilir.
Tek parça ya da düzenek, kapı ve kuyuda dayanak veya engel, evde direk ya da giysi askısı olabilir.
Yavrunun anasını emmesini önlemek için ağzına konan çubuk, engelleme işlevinin özel bir örneğidir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, bir araya getirilen ya da yerleştirilen ağaçların taşıt iskeleti, dayanak, askı ve engel olarak kullanıldığı nesne ailesini çeşitli örneklerle destekler.

Bir kuruluş, kişinin elini çenesinin altına koyup başını eline dayamasını anlatır.
Başka bir kuruluş, ağza çubuk sokarak ağzı açık duruma getirmeyi anlatır.

error_profile.preserves: Kişi ve devede yabancılığı, okta ödünçlük veya takıma ait olmamayı korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişi ya da devenin bulunduğu topluluğun asıl üyelerinden olmadığını anlatır.

error_profile.preserves: Canlının içinde bulunduğu topluluğa dışarıdan gelmiş olmasını korur.

contextual_glosses.text: ödünç ya da takıma uymayan ok
contextual_glosses.applicability: Okun ödünç olduğu, başka ağaçtan yapıldığı veya başka bir ok takımına karıştığı bağlam içindir.

error_profile.preserves: Okun ödünçlüğünü, farklı kökenini veya takıma ait olmayışını korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: yabancı kişi ya da deve; bazı aktarımlarda arkadaş veya karışmış kişi
ödünç ya da ait olmadığı okların arasına katılmış ok

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Yabancı deveyi ve ödünç ya da başka takıma karışmış oku da kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Yalnız başka bir insan topluluğuna girmiş yabancı erkeği adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: topluluk dışı unsur ile başka topluluktaki yabancı kişi
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da içinde bulunduğu insan topluluğunun asıl üyesi olmayan yabancı kişiyi anlatabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal canlılardan ok takımına uzanan daha geniş bir dışarıdan gelme ilişkisi taşır; komşu dal yalnız başka bir insan topluluğundaki yabancı kişidir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; başka topluluktaki yabancı kişi dalı canlı çekirdekle doğrudan örtüştü, kalanlar yalnız soy, yalnızlık veya davetsiz giriş alanındaydı.

branches.what_is_not_ar: السجير بالسين إذا ميزه المصدر والصديق إذا لم يثبت بالشين

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi resim veya desenin ağaç görünüşüne göre yapılmasını ve bu niteliğin ipekli kumaş üzerindeki özel kullanımını açıkça destekler. Bitkinin kendisi ile aynı biçimin askı anlamı dal dışında bırakılmıştır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal gerçek ağacı değil, ağaç biçiminde yapılmış resim veya deseni ve bu desenli kumaşı anlatır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın türemiş biçim ağaç biçimli resmi, kumaş kuruluşu ise yalnız ağaç desenli ipekli kumaşı bildirir.

concept_map.definition: Ağaç görünüşü örnek alınarak yapılmış resim veya desendir; kumaşa bağlı kullanımda yüzeyi böyle bir ağaç deseniyle işlenmiş ipekli kumaşı anlatır.

facets.statement: Resim ya da desen, ağacın biçimini veya genel görünüşünü yeniden üretir.
İpekli kumaşın yüzeyindeki işleme veya desen ağaç görünüşündedir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar ağaç biçiminde yapılmış resim ve deseni ortak çekirdek olarak verir; ipekli kumaş üzerindeki ağaç desenini bunun özel uygulaması olarak destekler.

concept_gloss.text: ağaç biçimli resim ya da desen
concept_gloss.applicability: Genel görsel biçimi ve kumaş üzerindeki özel uygulamayı doğal ve kısa biçimde karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Ağacın örnek alınmasını ve sonucun resim ya da desen olmasını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir yüzeydeki resim veya bezemenin ağaç biçiminde olduğunu bildiren bağlamlarda uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Desenin ağaç görünüşünü örnek alması anlamını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Ağaç biçimli desenin ipekli kumaş üzerinde bulunduğu özel kuruluş içindir.

error_profile.preserves: İpekli kumaşı ve yüzeyindeki ağaç biçimli deseni birlikte korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: ağaç biçiminde resmedilmiş ya da desenlenmiş

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Her tür ağacın genel biçimini örnek alan resim ve deseni kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Özellikle hurma salkımlarını ve hurma görünümlerini, ayrıca insan biçimli tasvirleri de kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: ağaç deseni ile hurma salkımı tasviri
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da hurma dahil bir ağacın görünüşünü bezeme veya tasvir olarak yeniden üretir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal ağaç görünüşünü genel bir desen ilkesi yapar; komşu dal hurma salkımı biçimine özgü tasviri ve başka figürleri de içeren ayrı bir adlandırmadır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Desenin belirleyici özelliği ağaç biçimini yeniden üretmesidir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Kısa ve yakın çizgileri, ince işlemeyi ve konusu ağaç olmak zorunda olmayan bezemeyi kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: ağaç biçimli desen ile sık ince çizgili bezeme
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal kumaş veya başka bir yüzey üzerindeki bezeme ve desen alanında kesişir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalı desenin konusu olan ağaç biçimi belirler; komşu dalı ise çizgilerin inceliği, yakınlığı ve genel süsleme işlemi belirler.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; hurma tasviri ile sık çizgili bezeme, sırasıyla konu ve çizgi yapısı bakımından en yararlı iki sınırı sağladı.

branches.what_is_not_ar: الشجر النبات نفسه والمشجر بمعنى المشجب أو الخشب
branches.source_phrase_ar: المشجر ضرب من التصاوير على صفة الشجر (ayn)؛ ديباج مشجر نقشه على هيئة الشجر (sihah)؛ المشجر من التصاوير ما يصور على صيغة الشجر (tahdhib)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, yalnız belirli bir kişi kuruluşunda ağaç imgesini köken ve soy için kullanan olumlu bir mecazı açıkça verir. Dal yalın ağaç anlamına ya da bütün köken kullanımlarına genişletilmeden korunabilir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Anlam, bir kişinin kutlu ve değerli bir soydan geldiğini bildiren özel kuruluşla sınırlıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Köken ve soy anlamı yalnız kutlu ağaçtan gelme kuruluşuna bağlıdır; yalın biçime genel köken anlamı verilmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir kişinin kutlu, değerli ve iyi bir soydan geldiğini ağaç ile köken arasında bağ kurarak anlatan özel bir soy ifadesidir.

facets.statement: Ağaç imgesi kişinin kökenini temsil eder ve bu köken olumlu, kutlu bir soy olarak değerlendirilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Bu dal, yalnız belirli bir soy bildiren ifadede kullanılan olumlu bir köken benzetmesine dayanır.

source_details.summary: İfade, bir kişinin kutlu ve değerli bir soydan geldiğini ağaç üzerinden anlatır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Yalnız kişinin kökenini olumlu ağaç benzetmesiyle bildiren özel kuruluşu karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Kişinin kökenini, soy ilişkisini ve bu soyun kutlu değerlendirilmesini korur.

contextual_glosses.text: kutlu ve değerli bir soydan gelmek
contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişinin kökeninin olumlu ve saygın olduğunu açıklayan bağlamda doğal karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Soydan gelme ilişkisini ve kökenin olumlu değerlendirilmesini korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Kökeni ağaç benzetmesiyle ve özellikle kutlu, olumlu bir değer yükleyerek anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Kişinin kökenini, yetiştiği yeri ve toplumsal konumunu olumlu ya da olumsuz değer zorunluluğu olmadan anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: kutlu soy benzetmesi ile genel köken
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da bir kişinin geldiği soy ve kökeni bildirebilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal belirli bir ağaç benzetmesine ve olumlu soy değerlendirmesine bağlıdır; komşu dal ise kişinin kökenini ve konumunu daha genel biçimde adlandırır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; genel kişi kökeni dalı doğrudan soy örtüşmesi verdi, kalanlar daha geniş köken, akrabalık veya özel ad alanlarına kaydı.

Uzaklaştırma, topluluk dışından gelme, ağaç biçimli desen ve ağacı soy-köken imgesi olarak kullanma dalları da ayrı anlam kümeleri oluşturur.
